 "data": "---
config:
 layout: elk
---
flowchart TD
 START[\"POST /user/id/jobs&#40;JobCreate&#41;\"] --> INSPECT{\"inspect_job&#40;&#41;<br/>필수 필드 검증\"}
 INSPECT -->|실패| ERR400[\"400 검증 실패 응답\"]
 INSPECT -->|통과| ASSIGN[\"_assign_available_gpu&#40;&#41;\"]

 ASSIGN --> CHK24{\"가용 24GB GPU?\"}
 CHK24 -->|있음| USE24[\"24GB GPU 사용<br/>isAvailable=false\"]
 CHK24 -->|없음| CHK8{\"가용 8GB GPU?\"}
 CHK8 -->|있음| USE8[\"8GB GPU 사용<br/>isAvailable=false\"]
 CHK8 -->|없음| NONE[\"GPU 없음&#40;None&#41;\"]

 USE24 --> RUNNING[\"status=running<br/>gpuId 설정, started_at 기록\"]
 USE8 --> RUNNING
 NONE --> PENDING[\"status=pending<br/>gpuId=None, queueNumber 부여\"]

 RUNNING --> INSERT[\"get_next_job_id&#40;&#41;<br/>jobs.insert_one&#40;&#41;\"]
 PENDING --> INSERT
 INSERT --> RESP[\"JobResponse 반환\"]

 subgraph RELEASE[\"Job 조회 시마다 자동 정리\"]
 SCAN[\"completed / failed<br/>&amp; gpuId 존재하는 Job 스캔\"] --> FREE[\"GPU 해제<br/>isAvailable=true, completed_at 기록\"]
 FREE --> QUEUE[\"_process_queued_jobs&#40;&#41;<br/>가장 오래된 pending Job에 재배정 → running\"]
 end
",
 "config": null
